title: A shift-compatible right adjoint of a triangulated functor is triangulated
statement: Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be pre-triangulated categories [def-weil-triangulated-category], with their additive integer shifts [def-weil-pbc-triangles-with-shift]. Let $F:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ and $G:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ be functors equipped with coherent shift isomorphisms $F(X[m])\cong F(X)[m]$ and $G(Y[m])\cong G(Y)[m]$ for every $m\in\mathbf Z$. Suppose $F\dashv G$ and its unit and counit commute with these shift isomorphisms, and suppose $F$ is exact (carries distinguished triangles to distinguished triangles). Then $G$ is exact with its specified shift isomorphisms.
